items.title: Polanski vows to stay as Green leader as he faces criticism after by-election defeat
items.summary: Jewish Greens' leader has said Polanski should resign in the wake of a Zionism row and by-election defeat.

items.title: Widdecombe murder 'politically and ideologically motivated'
items.summary: Ann Widdecombe's murder is alleged to have been "politically and ideologically motivated", a court has heard.

items.title: Widdecombe suspect had 'particular hostility to Reform', court told
items.summary: Kerry is charged with the murder of the 78-year-old former Conservative minister and Reform UK spokeswoman.

items.title: Michelle O'Neill invited for police interview over Garvaghy Road protest
items.summary: Michelle O'Neill says she has received a letter inviting her for a police interview in relation to her involvement in a Garvaghy Road protest.

items.title: King pays Andrew's £1.5m repair bill on Royal Lodge
items.summary: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor was charged £1.5m in repair and restoration costs after surrendering the lease on the 30-room mansion.

items.title: Flydubai co-pilot planned to crash aircraft into Ben Gurion airport, UAE says
items.summary: The UAE attorney general has said the alleged hijacker of a flydubai plane planned to crash into Israel's Ben Gurion airport.
